cases.reason: The conditional mixed outcome agrees against both 2000 and 2007, but that agreement alone does not establish which empirical finding is re-tested. Re-check actual target identity under the closest-study rule before any isolated outcome fix.

prior_incremental_acceptance.rationale: The abstract and introduction explicitly identify Fenton/Ohlsson2000 as the intended original retest; the 2007 replication is separately described as a methodological/comparison source. The authors report agreement on fault concentration, size prediction and density, but explicitly contrast cross-phase fault persistence with the retained original. Confirming the persistence hypothesis is not confirmation of the original’s rejection of it. Both blind coders and source adjudication support mixed for the positively identified 2000 target.
limits: The operational-fault dataset is incomplete and complexity hypothesisH6 is not tested. Authors explicitly explain the conditional persistence test and retain the original-specific contrary conclusion.
Figures are represented by labels/annotations; main-text comparison tables and discussion provide the outcome evidence.

The closest-chain alternative is preserved: the 2007 paper is not automatically added or excluded as a separate target. The retained2000target is positively supported by explicit current-study aims and original-specific comparisons, not merely its being the chain’s earliest paper.
